outcome: maternal and neonatal mortality and morbidity
cohort: 48 pregnant patients at risk of premature rupture of membrane (PROM) at Zagazig University Hospital in Egypt.
finding: Supplementation with lactoferrin may reduce the risk of premature rupture of membrane, though not significantly in this small study.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean) between women supplemented with lactoferrin and those receiving placebo.
